page.layout: One page of text. Across the top: a decorative ornament, then the title "HISTORIA IURIS" with the subtitle "A IUSTINIANO Compositi." (both centred). Below them a list of seven lines in the left column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Then a centred heading "DE NOVO CODICE faciendo ad Senatum urbis Constantinopolitanae.", an italic greeting line, and a body paragraph in the left column beginning with a decorated initial. The right margin holds two notes, a and b. The page number is at the top right. The gathering signature "bb" is centred at the foot.

main_text.head: HISTORIA IURIS
A IUSTINIANO Compositi.
main_text.l: D E novo Codice faciendo ad Senatum urbis Constantinopolitanae anno 528.ad differentiam Gregoriani, Hermogeniani & Theodosiani. est tamen vetus habita ratione ad eū quo nunc vtimur de quo].
D E Justinianeo Codice confirmando ad Mennam anno 529.
D E Conceptione Digestorum ad Tribonianum anno 530.
D E Confirmatione Institutionum ad cupidam legum iuventutem anno 533.
D E Confirmatione Digestorum duplex constitutio ad senatus & omnes populos anno 533.
D E ratione & methodo iuris docendi ad Antecessores anno 533.
D E emendatione Codicis Iustiniani & secunda eius editione ad Senatum urbis Constantinopolitanae anno 534.
main_text.head: DE NOVO{a} CODICE{b} faciendo ad Senatum urbis Constantinopolitanae.

p.i: Imperator IUSTINIANUS Augustus ad Senatum urbis Constantinopolitanae.

main_text.p: AEC quæ necessario corrigenda esse multis retro principibus visa sunt, interea tamen nullus eorum ad effectum ducere ausus est: in præsenti rebus donare communibus auxilio Dei omnipo-Prudentes responsa sua chartis aut membranis solebant conscribere. Constitutiones vero & rescripta Codicibus & pugil-larib. charta-ceis, ligneis, aneis vel eburneis moris erat [?]scribi: quæ postea in scriniis memoriæ & dispositionum seruabantur. Eo factum est vt liber constitutionum po-tius Codicis quàm memo-branarum no-men obtinue-rit. Cyiac.[?]

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "pscribi" in note b is printed with a long s and may read "scribi"; the note letter "a" in the left-column heading and the mark in note a "de quo]." (closing bracket) are doubtful; "Cyiac." at the end of note b may read "Cuiac." ; "necessario" may carry a tilde over the final o. The initial "A" is a decorated woodcut letter, transcribed as "AEC". The text ends on "omnipo-" with the word continuing on the next page. Long s and u/v, i/j spellings have been normalised per the rules, including "Iustinianeo" and "IUSTINIANO" with I as consonant, following the rule for i/j. Notes a and b are placed at the first list line and at the paragraph start for position in the reading order.
